snippet.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Fantasia Officially Releases!
snippet.description:
The game "Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Fantasia" has officially launched on the G123 game service! 

Start playing here: https://s.g123.jp/i3kup91k

The game is a heartwarming yet chaotic RPG in which Miss Kobayashi and her companions find themselves trapped in a VR game world due to an unexpected bug. Working together, they must survive the challenges of the game world and search for a way back to reality.
Welcome beloved characters such as Tohru and Kanna as allies, each equipped with classic RPG job gear such as warrior, mage, archer, and thief, as you work to escape from being trapped in a VR game world.

■ Basic Game Info
Game Title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Fantasia
Genre: Heartwarming & Chaotic RPG
Price: Free-to-play (in-game purchases available)
Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean

#DragonMaid #G123 #FreeGame #NewGame
